lead: Lalu Prasad Yadav is an Indian politician, born on 11 June 1948 in Gopalganj.
As of 2026, he is 78 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and Member of the Bihar Legislative Assembly.
Below you will find a verified overview of Lalu Prasad Yadav: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Lalu Prasad Yadav — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha, Member of the Bihar Legislative Assembly, Minister of Railways (2004–2009), Member of the 12th Lok Sabha, Member of the 9th Lok Sabha (1989–1991) and Chief Minister of Bihar (1990–1997). He is affiliated with Rashtriya Janata Dal.

sections.heading: Lalu Prasad Yadav — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Rabri Devi (married 1973).
He is a parent to Tejashwi Yadav, Tej Pratap Yadav, Misa Bharati Devi, Rohini Devi, Raj Lakshmi Yadav and Anushka Yadav.
